raw_text: Pakistan plunged into chaos following the arrest of PTI chairman Imran Khan by Rangers at the Islamabad High Court. Mob attacks on military installations were reported in Lahore, Rawalpindi, and Peshawar. The Lahore Corps Commander's house was set ablaze. Authorities imposed Section 144 in all major cities and shut down mobile internet and social media services nationwide.
